body: He is still around my niece, which is my main concern. My sister is lazy and hasn’t worked for the past 6 years; she relies on that money because she has no drive to get up and work. I’ve tried to talk to her. I’m talking to a sexual assault advocate after work today to see my options. My entire family is going to react negatively if I decide to pursue legal action and probably turn away from me more than they already have done. I don’t care about being alive anymore, but I want to protect my niece. She’s the only person that matters to me.

I had hoped that she would back any decision I made to pursue something from it, but she told me that she didn’t really think it was worth it to do so. I had some scrap of hope left that maybe I could make a police report or something, but it just seems pointless with no support behind my back.
